title: Summarize all matching scoped approved order sales by original currency
description: A user sees a currency-separated overview of all matching approved order evidence for the selected dates/customer/currency, regardless of detail page/selected columns. Add a narrow summary DTO/rules and summary endpoint using ERP-223 freshly authorized bounded source before detail page projection. Reuse existing 500-order/10000-detail caps and fail explicitly without partial aggregates on overflow. Group supported original Currency codes in stable order, expose approved order count and signed SalesAmount subtotal in each original currency; unknown/blank/invalid currency rows are an explicitly unknown bucket with count but null monetary subtotal, never zero. Count all matching bounded-source orders, not current-page rows; identify coverage as all matching within enforced caps and retain effective filters/dates/limits and unknown-cost evidence. Never total costs/current-price estimates/profits, convert currencies, sum different currencies or call order amounts collected/realized revenue. Designer loads summary with current filters and renders unit-independent currency rows and empty/denied/error states; changing page/columns cannot alter summary, changing filters must refresh it. Development only: reuse existing order-profit menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService, approved nondeleted scoped SalesOrders and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Do not accept client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority or widen ERP permissions. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated work. Run focused in-memory API/service/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any unavailable external environment acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Summary endpoint revalidates dates/filters and rechecks identity/order-profit menu/current scope, grouping the same bounded source before detail pagination; cap overflow returns no partial summary.

Stable original-currency groups carry all-matching order counts and signed known-currency sales totals; unknown currency has null total with explicit evidence, and no cost/profit/current-price or cross-currency total is produced.

Designer renders all-matching currency summary with current dates/filters/limits and unknown-cost context, independent of page/selected fields; focused API/UI tests and detail Excel/PDF regressions plus safe Release build/test pass.
